sentences.text: Shri Mohd. Rafik Sheikh, Advocate for the appellant.
Shri Rahul Solanki, Government Advocate for the respond Heard on the question of admission.
Appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A. No.12653/2023, which is first application filed under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant - Munshilal.

2 . Learned Trial Court has convicted the appellant under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC and sentenced him to undergo RI for 04 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, RI for 10 years with fine of Rs.2,000/-, RI for 04 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- and RI for 01 year with fine of Rs.1,000/-
respectively with default stipulations, vide judgement of conviction and order of sentence dated 24.07.2023 passed by the 1st Additional Sessions Judge, Neemuch in S.T. No.33/2022.

3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that the appellant committed forgery by making forged agreement to sale of disputed land in favour of the complainant Laxminarayan and he cheated him by taking Rs.2,50,000/- from him.
4 . Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.

The complainant and other material witnesses have not supported the case of prosecution in their deposition but the Trial Court has not considered their statement properly and has wrongly convicted and sentenced the appellant in the offence.
During trial, the appellant was in jail since 15.06.2022 to 27.01.2023 and thereafter, he is in custody since the date of judgement i.e. 24.07.2023.
Final hearing of this appeal is not possible in near future therefore, it is prayed that the remaining jail sentence of appellant may be suspended and he be released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State has objected the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.

6. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
7.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that final disposal of this appeal is not possible in near future, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
I.A.No.12653/2023 is allowed and jail sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended.

8. It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, appellant shall be released on bail, on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 22.12.2023, and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
